summary: Comprehensive testing of 5 new FX Trading Tracker enhancements: (1) Cancel/Recall with mandatory reason, (2) Transaction types Today/Tomorrow/Spot, (3) Transfer types FX Crypto Conversion/FX Local/PDAX Withdrawal, (4) Bank vs Crypto toggle on From/To sections, (5) Ours (Receiving Account) section. All 18 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed via Playwright.

Backend: Transfer types list returns FX Crypto Conversion, FX Local, PDAX Withdrawal
Backend: Create deal with Bank type for From section - bank/account saved

Backend: Create deal with mixed types (Bank From, Crypto To)
Backend: Create deal with Ours Bank type - bank/account saved
Backend: Create deal with Ours Crypto type - wallet address saved
Backend: Deal detail returns all Ours section fields
Backend: Cancel without reason returns 400
Backend: Cancel with whitespace-only reason returns 400
Backend: Cancel deal success - status becomes cancelled, cancellation_reason saved
Backend: Cancel already-cancelled deal returns 400
Backend: Cancel confirmed deal returns 400
Backend: Deal detail shows cancellation_reason for cancelled deals
Backend: Treasury cannot cancel deals (403)
Backend: Filter by cancelled status works correctly
Backend: Dashboard stats includes cancelled_deals count
Frontend: Transaction Type dropdown shows Today, Tomorrow, Spot
Frontend: Transfer Type dropdown shows FX Crypto Conversion, FX Local, PDAX Withdrawal
Frontend: Bank/Crypto toggle on Source (From) section - Bank shows Bank+Account, Crypto shows Wallet Address
Frontend: Bank/Crypto toggle on Destination (To) section - Bank shows Bank+Account, Crypto shows Wallet Address

Frontend: Cancel dialog has mandatory cancellation reason field

seed_data_creation: Multiple test deals created with TEST_ prefix for various scenarios: Bank type, Crypto type, mixed types, cancel testing, filter testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 new enhancements have been fully tested. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_enhancements.py cover: transaction types, transfer types, bank/crypto toggles, ours section, cancel/recall functionality. The DealCreate model includes: from_type, to_type, ours_type (bank/crypto), from_wallet_address, to_wallet_address, ours_wallet_address, ours_bank, ours_account_num, cancellation_reason, cancelled_at. Cancel endpoint at PUT /api/deals/{deal_id}/cancel requires cancellation_reason in body.

enhancement_1_cancel_recall.details: Cancel/Recall button appears for pending deals in deal detail dialog. Cancel dialog requires mandatory cancellation reason. Cancel without reason returns 400. Cancel already-cancelled or confirmed deal returns 400. Treasury cannot cancel deals (403). Cancellation reason displayed in deal detail after cancellation. cancelled_at timestamp recorded.

enhancement_2_transaction_types.details: Transaction Type dropdown shows exactly: Today, Tomorrow, Spot. Old transaction types removed. API /api/reference/transaction-types returns correct values.

enhancement_3_transfer_types.details: Transfer Type dropdown shows exactly: FX Crypto Conversion, FX Local, PDAX Withdrawal. Old transfer types removed. API /api/reference/transfer-types returns correct values.

enhancement_4_bank_crypto_toggle.details: Bank/Crypto toggle present on Source (From) and Destination (To) sections. Bank mode shows Company, Bank dropdown, Account Number fields. Crypto mode shows Company, Wallet Address field (Bank and Account Number hidden). Toggle resets dependent fields when switched. DealCreate model has from_type, to_type fields with conditional validation.

enhancement_5_ours_section.details: Ours (Receiving Account) section added to New Deal form with Bank/Crypto toggle. Bank mode shows Bank dropdown + Account Number. Crypto mode shows Wallet Address. Section highlighted in yellow in deal detail and treasury review dialogs. API stores ours_type, ours_bank, ours_account_num, ours_wallet_address.

error_responses: 400 - Deal already cancelled or not pending
